verdict.rationale: Airbyte Cloud docs confirm it can send notifications for connection events to a webhook endpoint, satisfying the basic 'subscribe to events via webhook' capability, though this is a general ops/notification feature rather than something framed or extended for AI-native/agentic consumption (e.g., no mention of structured event payloads for agent workflows or webhook management via API/MCP). Missing for 10: documentation tying webhooks to AI-agent workflows, configurable event types beyond sync success/failure, and independent/hands-on verification of the webhook feature working in practice.
